# Fornax Labs

> Fornax Labs is an agentic AI platform for small and mid-sized businesses. Its agents pick up requests from the channels a business already uses (email, WhatsApp, web forms and business tools), work out what is needed, do the routine work, and bring in a person for anything sensitive. Every run is tracked end to end. Ready-made playbooks cover client servicing, finance operations and marketing.

- Website: https://fornaxlabs.xyz/
- Contact: sales@fornaxlabs.xyz

## The platform

- [Fornax Labs home](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/): The platform, use cases, how it works, agent tracking and approvals, and an FAQ.
- Channels: email is live; WhatsApp and web forms are rolling out with pilot customers; business tools connect through integrations.
- Client servicing: client requests for mutual fund distributors, insurance brokers and CA and tax firms, turned into tracked work (see Sugamkar).
- Finance operations: invoice capture and reconciliation against bank feeds, accounts receivable follow-ups, expense categorisation and anomaly flagging, monthly cash-flow reporting.
- Marketing: content planning and drafting, campaign performance reporting from ad platforms, lead research and outreach drafts, competitor monitoring.
- Oversight: every step, tool call and decision is logged; sensitive actions are routed for approval; time saved, success rate and spend are tracked per agent.

## Sugamkar (first product)

- [Sugamkar](https://fornaxlabs.xyz/site/sugamkar): An agent for advisors, distributors and service firms. It reads client messages from email, WhatsApp and web forms, recognises each request (for example an SIP change, a renewal or a tax notice), and puts the work on one list with an assignee and a status. Personally identifiable information (PII) and sensitive personal information (SPI) are masked before AI processing, and nothing is sent without approval. Open for pilots with mutual fund distributors.
